$schema-comment: Size caps for the rendered prompt. UTF-8 byte counts. The CI gate fails if the actual size exceeds the cap. Caps are intentionally close to current size so 0.0.P trim work has headroom without inviting regression.

max_prompt_bytes.why: Current rendered prompt is ~12.2 KB post-0.0.P trim (down from ~17 KB pre-trim — 29.6% reduction). Cap LOWERED from 18500 to lock in the win while leaving ~1.8 KB headroom for 0.0.O schema directive. Each future addition pays a meaningful tax; deliberate. See CHANGELOG [0.6.20].

max_prompt_lines.why: Current is ~272 lines post-0.0.P (down from ~362 — 25% reduction). Cap LOWERED from 380 to lock in the win while leaving ~38 lines headroom for 0.0.O. See CHANGELOG [0.6.20].
